item.title: Understanding the Role of Lithium Metal Microstructure in Chemo-Mechanical Instability of Solid-State Batteries
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study uniquely links polycrystalline Li anode microstructure to void-driven interfacial contact loss in solid-state batteries via a mesoscale model informed by atomics. It shows small grains promote self-diffusion healing, and quantifies how pressure, current, and temperature affect stripping across microstructures. Significance: incorporating microstructure is essential for predicting anode–electrolyte contact evolution and enabling practical areal capacities.

💡 In situ growth of carbon nanotubes directly on LiFePO₄ eliminates dispersion steps, creating particle-level conductive networks for solvent-free dry electrodes.
